g.text: Layers between the mobile and the MSC
Connection Management: call control (CC), SMS, supplementary
Mobility Management: location update, authentication, TMSI
Radio Resource: channel set-up, handover, power control
Data link layer on the Um interface: framing and error handling
TDMA/FDMA, GMSK modulation, 200 kHz carriers, 8 time slots
Each layer talks only to the layer above and below
Peer layers on MS and network exchange protocol messages
Lower layers are radio specific, upper layers are service specific
MTP and SCCP carry signalling between NSS nodes
TCAP and MAP handle roaming and subscriber data
ISUP sets up trunks to the fixed network
Packet data on top of GSM
End-to-end delivery between MS and server
Addressing and routing across the PDN
Compresses and segments IP packets over the radio link
Reliable logical link between MS and SGSN
Radio block segmentation and channel access
